snippet.title: Metromino Beginner Guide | Tips Before You Play the Demo
snippet.description:
The Metromino demo is coming soon!

Before you start building your first city, here are a few useful tips to help you understand the main mechanics of the game.

In this video, you'll learn how to:

• Grow your city population
• Place roads efficiently
• Upgrade roads with tetromino pieces
• Improve buildings with city services
• Manage your city budget
• Generate income
• Avoid spending too much on unnecessary upgrades

Metromino is a casual city-building strategy game where you expand your city by placing roads using tetromino-shaped pieces.

As your city grows, space becomes limited, upgrades become more expensive, and planning becomes increasingly important.

Wishlist Metromino on Steam:
